failures.failure: The first local report-server launch using a hidden Start-Process wrapper was rejected by host policy before any process or output file was created.
failures.recovery: Use the supported bounded foreground execution session, retain its process identifier, serve only the local final staging root, and terminate it explicitly after browser checks.

failures.failure: The browser automatically requested an undeclared favicon and the bounded local server returned HTTP 404; the requested report itself returned HTTP 200.
failures.recovery: Retain the nonessential missing-resource request separately; rely only on the exact report response and zero browser console warnings or errors, without claiming a complete site deployment.

failures.failure: The first Node syntax-check invocation passed the validator .txt path directly; Node 24 rejected the unknown file extension before parsing the validator.
failures.recovery: Pipe the exact validator source through the supported stdin syntax-check route with explicit CommonJS input type; the syntax check then passes without changing validator bytes.

failures.failure: The first stdin-based final staged-review command omitted Node's explicit stdin script marker, so Node tried to load a module named final and exited before the staged-review source ran.
failures.recovery: Invoke the unchanged staged-review source with an explicit stdin script marker and pass final as the stage argument; no already-successful phase validation is replayed.

failures.failure: The first executed final staged review correctly surfaced three protected-real-data token candidates inside the canonical validator's own scanner-definition line and stopped before issuing a valid review.
failures.recovery: Classify only those three exact-path, exact-kind, scanner-definition-line matches as declared scanner-definition candidates, keep every other match fail-closed, and rerun only the missing final staged review.

failures.failure: The first complete staged-seal verifier compared semantically equal owner-count objects using property-order-sensitive JSON serialization and falsely failed at its final truth predicate.
failures.recovery: Compare recursively key-sorted values while retaining all preceding checks; regenerate only content-dependent final derivatives and rerun the dependency-corrected staged verifier.

failures.failure: A single compound PowerShell command combined artifact updating, copying, derivative removal, staged review, sealing, and verification; host command policy rejected it before any subcommand ran.
failures.recovery: Split the recovery into bounded state-checked commands, use the patch surface for exact generated-derivative removal, and validate each transition before proceeding.
